note: Verified gameplay clips. mbpublish will regenerate this from dev-smoke/<task>/media-manifest.json. Each clip is re-rendered from one boot-state load and hash-checked against the recorded run.

clips.title: The oracle plays S3
clips.caption: The oracle plays the whole S3 segment by itself — from the forest where S2 ends, through the cave, to picking up the Sleepy Toadstool. No human input, no saved states.

clips.title: The same run, real time
clips.caption: The first nine seconds of the S3 run at normal speed, as Link crosses two forest screens and enters the cave.

clips.title: Stuck at the cave door
clips.caption: The oracle's first S3 attempt reached the cave door and stepped back and forth beneath it until its 1,600-decision budget ran out. The cause was a 4-pixel tolerance.

clips.title: The crumbling-floor fall (before)
clips.caption: With the old oracle, Link keeps his shield up on the crumbling floor. A bat knocks him back, the floor gives way, and he falls.

clips.title: The crumbling-floor fix (after)
clips.caption: After the fix, the shield stays down on crumbling cells. Same start, same room — he walks across and finishes the segment.

clips.title: Two rock pushes in the cave
clips.caption: In cave room C:AB the oracle pushes one rock left and a second rock down to clear the way to the exit, at normal speed.

clips.title: Crossing the crumbling floor
clips.caption: In cave room C:BD the oracle walks Link around the room and across the crumbling floor to the top exit without any floor tile collapsing, at normal speed.

clips.title: Picking up the Sleepy Toadstool
clips.caption: In the forest the oracle walks Link to the Sleepy Toadstool, picks it up and waits through the message until the game records the item, at normal speed.

clips.title: Assigning an item in the menu
clips.caption: Inside the witch's hut the recorded teacher run opens the inventory, puts the Sleepy Toadstool on the A button and closes the menu again, at normal speed.

clips.title: Feather jump
clips.caption: In Tail Cave the recorded teacher run jumps over a pit with the Roc's Feather, lands on the far side and leaves the room, at normal speed.

clips.title: Arrival at the Tail Cave boss door
clips.caption: The last five seconds of the recorded teacher run, as Link walks up to the boss door of Tail Cave, at normal speed.
